metadata.description: Agent plugins for working with Unfold, for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code.

plugins.name: unfold
plugins.description: Use Unfold's MCP tools and link your agent sessions to Unfold Work Items. In Claude Code it also reports each session, records Agent Trace attribution for its commits, and can send Claude Code's usage metrics with the person's identity through its OpenTelemetry headers helper.
